name: Ditto

dims.source: TC Electronic Ditto Looper manual Technical Specifications 48 x 48 x 93 mm (W x H-overall x D), corroborated B&H 960801001 1.9 x 1.9 x 3.7 in. Bare enclosure h=1.26 in (32 mm) derived from side views in references/tc-electronic-ditto_measurements.md (published 48 mm is overall incl. knob). Original Ditto Looper only - not X2/X4/Ditto+.

enclosure.note: Custom mini box (no preset matches 48x93 mm). Flat top, rounded corners, charcoal sparkle powder coat.

knobs.note: Single LOOP LEVEL knob, centred. Photo-derived in two views (topdown + detail-knob, references/tc-electronic-ditto_measurements.md). mxr Davies body scaled 0.82 (~0.75 in dia) as nearest shared style for the TC mini knob; white pointer at ~7-8 o'clock in topdown (rot provisional).

led.note: Red LED centred below LOOPER print. Photo-derived in two views (topdown + hero34). Lit in all studio references.

footswitch.note: Round chrome stomp, centred. Photo-derived in two views (topdown + detail-footswitch).

jacks.note: INPUT on right wall (side-right view, 'input' wall print below jack). Explicit wall y (mid-wall in side views).
OUTPUT on left wall (side-left view). Explicit wall y.

labels.note: Small lowercase print at back edge above knob (topdown).
Large wordmark. Real O carries a waveform glyph; bold vector caps approximate it (see notes).
Brand line at front edge (topdown, detail-footswitch).

notes: TC Electronic Ditto (ORIGINAL Ditto Looper, mini 48x93 mm, single loop-level knob) hero - not the Ditto X2/X4/Ditto+. Flat box, no profile. All deck parts seat via surfaceAt() (flat deck h=1.26) - no hardcoded y on knob/LED/footswitch. powerJack is null: the real 9V barrel + mini-USB sit in a recess on the RIGHT side wall behind INPUT (side-right view), and parts.js powerJack() only builds back-wall jacks - the hero page stages the side recess locally and a shared side-wall power builder is reported as a shared need. Side-wall 'input'/'output' word print is likewise not deck text. No full-top decal (vector labels), so validate CHECK B is skipped. Positions photo-derived per references/tc-electronic-ditto_measurements.md; bare height and knob rot provisional as flagged there.
